description: A script for manipulating TP-Link 2022 images, including analysis, extraction, and creation of images with support for UBI root filesystem and optional fields like software version and support string.

methods.name: decode_header
methods.description: Reads and decodes the header of a tplink2022 image file into a dictionary.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts sections from a tplink2022 image file into separate binary files.

methods.name: get_section_contents
methods.description: Retrieves the data content of a section, either from memory or from a file.

methods.name: write_image
methods.description: Creates a tplink2022 image file from a header dictionary and section data.

methods.name: encode_soft_verson
methods.description: Encodes a placeholder software version; purpose unclear.

methods.name: create_image
methods.description: Creates a tplink2022 image with specified root filesystem and support string.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point handling analysis, extraction, or creation based on command-line arguments.
